hits.title: Entanglement between particle partitions in itinerant many-particle states
hits.snippet: We review `particle partitioning entanglement' for itinerant many-particle systems. This is defined as the entanglement between two subsets of particles making up the system. hits.snippet: Extending a previous result on the generation of two-photon generalized binomial field states, here we propose an efficient scheme to generate with high-fidelity, in a single-mode high-Q cavity, N-photon generalized binomial states with a maximum number of photons N>2. hits.title: Probabilistic Dense Coding Using Non-Maximally Entangled Three-Particle State
hits.snippet: We present a scheme of probabilistic dense coding via a quantum channel of non-maximally entangled three-particle state. The quantum dense coding will be succeeded with a certain probability if the sender introduces an auxiliary particle and performs a collective unitary transformation. Furthermore, the average information transmitted in this scheme is calculated.

hits.title: Studies on the Role of Entanglement in Mixed-state Quantum Computation
hits.snippet: In this thesis, I look at the role of quantum entanglement in mixed-state quantum computation. The model we consider is the DQC1 or `power of one qubit' model. hits.title: Loss of entanglement in quantum mechanics due to the use of realistic measuring rods
hits.snippet: We show that the use of real measuring rods in quantum mechanics places a fundamental gravitational limit to the level of entanglement that one can ultimately achieve in quantum systems.
